title: Cursed Colors
description:
Cursed Colors is a roguelite game, where the key to success lies on destroying enemies by matching different colors while you attack.
Every enemy has it weakness, exploit it to get an advantage and progress through the world.

If you fail, you start over.
But each time you fail you can get upgrades at the shop with loot dropped from your enemies.

Try out different combinations of upgrades and characters in order to optimize your favorite playstyle.Content• Thematic stages with different enemies and backgrounds.

• 5 unlockable characters with different skills.

• Original Soundtracks for each stage.

• Challenging boss fights.
description_short: Match colors & click on your enemies to progress in this roguelite game.
